xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnComposition:
The Board of Directors at their Meeting held on 2nd December,2025 have noted and accepted the resignation of Shri Vivek Chawla from the postion of Whole-time Director w.e.f the closure of business hours on 5th December,2025.
The Board of Directors at the same meeting held on 2nd December,2025 have appointed Shri Sushil Kumar Khetan , CEO of the Company as an Addtional Director - Designated as Whole-time Director & CEO of the Company w.e.f 6th December,2025.
Intimation of the appointment and resignation was intimated to the Stock Exchanges on 2nd December,2025.
Further, the shareholders of the Company through Postal Ballot ( remote e-voting) held on 8th January,2026 have approved the said appointment of Shri Sushil Kumar Khetan as Whole-time Director & CEO of the Company.
Intimation of the said approval by the shareholders were intimated to the stock exchanges on 9th January,2026.
